subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, and under what bounded retention and visibility policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but preserving unmentioned group media changes what later prompts can see and now conflicts with an intentional no-download privacy/no-spam behavior added for unmentioned media.

options.title: Approve Bounded Image Retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it to later turns under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep Text-Only Skipped History
options.body: Keep the current no-download behavior for unmentioned requireMention group media and document that historical media is unavailable unless the current turn is addressed or explicitly ingested.

options.title: Require Live Design Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue open until a live Telegram proof demonstrates the failure and validates a proposed retention policy without bystander-media exposure.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Image Retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it to later turns under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Telegram group-history policy documentation and scoped AGENTS.md invariants make obviyus the closest owner signal for the product/security boundary.
